audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart marks Level 3 and Level 6 as 'Skill', but the why-lines and the packet levelChart say Darius owns Level 3 and Warwick owns Level 6 outright. breakdown.difficulty also says 7.5/10 while diffRating and the Final Matchup Rating say 5.5/10.
audit.why: Level 6 is Warwick's single favoured window (Infinite Duress); Level 3 is a clean Darius kill window before his sub-50% healing exists. The chart should not hedge where the prose does not.
audit.corrected: Level 3 = Darius, Level 6 = Warwick; difficulty aligned to 5.5/10 in all three fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text lists 'Infinite Duress online, level 6, first item' with no numbers, and never states that Warwick's power is gated on YOUR health bar rather than on levels.
audit.why: Eternal Hunger heals only below 50% health and triples below 25%; Blood Hunt (80/70/60/50/40s) activates on its own when you drop below 50% and triples below 25%. Infinite Duress is 110/90/70s and its leap distance scales with his bonus move speed, so Blood Hunt on you literally lengthens his ult.
audit.corrected: Spikes rewritten around the 50% and 25% health thresholds and the real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Primal Howl is never mentioned anywhere in this matchup, and Jaws of the Beast is described only as 'sustain'.
audit.why: Riot's text: Primal Howl (15/14/13/12/11s) gives Warwick damage reduction for 2.5 seconds and then, at the end or on re-cast, makes nearby enemies FLEE for 1 second — that fear ends a Darius run-down and the damage reduction eats a full-stack burst. Jaws of the Beast deals damage based on the target's MAXIMUM health and heals him for the damage dealt, so stacking raw health both increases his damage and increases his heal.
audit.corrected: Primal Howl's damage reduction and fear added; Jaws of the Beast's max-health scaling connected to itemization.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization recommends Dead Man's Plate and names no anti-heal, in a matchup whose first Do is 'Anti-heal his Q sustain'.
audit.why: Jaws of the Beast scales off your maximum health, so a health item hands him damage and healing; Eternal Hunger, Jaws of the Beast and Infinite Duress all heal, so Grievous Wounds is mandatory rather than situational.
audit.corrected: Health stacking flagged, Executioner's timing written in.
